Several strong open‑source Opsgenie alternatives exist in 2025, offering on‑call scheduling, alert routing, and incident management without vendor lock‑in. The most capable options include Iris, OnCall, OpenDuty, Cabot, and Grafana OnCall. Each caters to slightly different infrastructure and team‑size needs.onpage+2
